gen-gf-unkempt-gf-bai-jamjuree: Unkempt has a crossbar and stem that match in weight, so every t looks hand-cut. Bai Jamjuree follows with light, open rounds and no thick-and-thin shifts, which keeps a long paragraph moving easily under that loud heading.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-barlow: Unkempt shouts with expressive, commanding letters whose c never collapses into an o. Barlow takes over below with tips pulled well apart and neon-tube strokes, so a modest bump in its size would keep it comfortable.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-biz-udgothic: BIZ UDGothic gives the body a wide channel into every bowl, modern and businesslike in feel. And against Unkempt's pipe-cleaner strokes up top, a long stretch of this sans-serif text feels steady and easy to follow.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-biz-udpgothic: Unkempt draws every stroke unshaded and constant, with a commanding hand. BIZ UDPGothic sits beneath it with lavish spacing and clear channels into round letters, so the plain sans text gives the loud heading room to breathe.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-bpmf-huninn: Bpmf Huninn brings a single-weight outline feel and a wide channel into every bowl, modern and quiet. And Unkempt above it supplies the expressive punch, so the sans text simply lets the heading do the talking.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Rough, bold, and outlined by one steady thickness, Unkempt grabs attention first, with counters traced in a single line. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std reads gently, its strokes swelling and thinning in small steps across a long page.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-cairo: Unkempt arrives expressive and commanding, every line the same unvarying thickness. Cairo then settles underneath with a wide channel into every bowl, and the plain sans text makes a modern, businesslike counterweight to that bold heading.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-cairo-play: Unkempt runs a single flat line weight through every glyph, giving the heading a bold, expressive voice. But Cairo Play answers with open round letters that stay clear at small sizes, a modern sans-serif body underneath.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-cambay: Unkempt carries a gentle monotone of line thickness, with a commanding, expressive character up top. And Cambay, a contemporary sans-serif, has rounds that gap like a cracked bangle, so nudging its size up a little helps.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-cantarell: Unkempt looks expressive and commanding, with a crossbar and stem that match in weight. Cantarell, the plain sans below, is approachable and tidy, its r, n and m arches matching their stems, which is the pair's best quality.
